P1: 湛蓝市 is a small, seaside town on a separate landmass to the southwest of mainland Johto. Despite its distance, many Trainers still brave the waters of Routes 40号道路 and 41号道路 to challenge the Cianwood Gym, or to visit a centuries-old pharmacy known for its unique medicine. Cliff Edge Gate leads west to Routes 47号道路 and 48号道路, but the 狩猎地带 at the end is still under construction.
M1: If the player has only one Pokémon
D1: Between the two middle drying racks (hidden)
D2: Held by Shuckie, a 壶壶 received from Kirk for safekeeping
D3: Cianwood City Pharmacy; after speaking with Jasmine in Olivine Lighthouse
D4: From Gym Leader Chuck, after defeating him
D5: In front of Cianwood Gym; from Chuck's wife, after defeating her husband
D6: Next to the northernmost house (hidden; requires 碎岩)
P2: The Cianwood City Pharmacy is located on the south side of town, and has served as the local Poké Mart for the last 500 years. Inform the shopkeeper of the situation in Olivine Lighthouse to receive the SecretPotion, a powerful remedy only dispensed in emergencies.
P3: After dispensing the SecretPotion, the shopkeeper offers traditional medicine for sale.
P4: The house in the southwest part of town belongs to a PokéManiac. Speak to him to learn that he was bullied by someone with "piercing eyes and long hair" into giving up one of his Pokémon. He still has one left, but is afraid of what will happen if the thief returns. He asks that you take his remaining Pokémon, a 壶壶, for safekeeping.
P5: He will eventually ask for his Shuckle back, but will decide to let you keep it if it has grown friendly enough toward you.
C1:
Cianwood City Pokémon Gym
Leader: Chuck
His Roaring Fists Do The Talking
P6: The Cianwood Gym specializes in 格斗 Pokémon. Fighting-type moves are super effective against 恶-, 冰-, 一般-, 岩石-, and 钢 Pokémon, while Fighting-type Pokémon are weak to 飞行- and 超能力 moves.
P7: The Gym is designed to mimic a cliffside, with an artificial waterfall under which the Gym Leader can be seen meditating. First, climb up the west side to battle Black Belt Yoshi and Black Belt Nob. When Nob approaches you, he blocks off the stairway to the uppermost level from this direction. On the east side, battle Black Belt Lao, then cross over the bridge to reach a red button on the west side's uppermost level. Pressing this button turns the winch and raises the pipe, stopping the flow of water.
P8: Chuck's 火暴猴 has a high 攻击 stat, allowing it to deal considerable damage already. Using 瞪眼 cuts the foe's 防御, and 岩崩 lets it fight back against 飞行 Pokémon. His 蚊香泳士 can lull the target to 睡眠 with 催眠术, and 泰山压顶 may cause 麻痹. As a 水 Pokémon, it is also vulnerable to 草- and 电 moves. Both Pokémon have access to 真气拳, the strongest Fighting-type move and one that forces the user to first spend a turn readying its attack. If the user is hit before it can strike, the move fails. Healing items like 解眠药 and 零余果 will be helpful, as will using moves like 反射壁 to boost your Pokémon's 防御.
P9: After the battle, Chuck awards you the 风暴徽章, which ensures obedience of all Pokémon up to level 70 and enables the use of 飞翔 in the field. He also gives you 招式学习器01（真气拳） as a prize.
P10: Upon leaving the Gym, Chuck's wife immediately notices your new 风暴徽章, and gives you 秘传学习器02（飞翔）. This field move allows a Trainer to quickly return to any familiar location. She comments how it is a good thing that her husband was defeated, as it gives him a reason to train.
P11: The northeast house belongs to the Cameron, the Photographer. He is not home, but a relative of his invites you to use the camera set up outside to take pictures with your party Pokémon.
P12: The far north end of the beach holds a small hill at the foot of the cliffs. It is here that you have your first sighting of the legendary 水君 since it fled from the 烧焦塔. When you get too close, it races around you before running out over the waves. Eusine appears a moment later, and challenges you to a battle in order to prove himself to the legendary beast.
P13: Eusine has a diverse team of Pokémon, but there is still some overlap in weaknesses. His 催眠貘 can lull the target to sleep with 催眠术 before stealing its health with 食梦. 鬼斯通's 黑色目光 prevents escape while 诅咒 cuts its health in order to afflict the target. Both of these Pokémon are vulnerable to 幽灵- and 恶 attacks. As an 电 Pokémon, his 顽皮雷弹 takes serious damage only from 地面 moves.
P14: After the battle, Eusine promises to keep searching for 水君, and bids you farewell until your next meeting.
P15: Return to the Olivine Lighthouse and take the elevator to the top floor to deliver the SecretPotion to Jasmine. She administers the medicine to Amphy, and its vitality and light is restored. Seeing it returned to full health, Jasmine promises to return to the Olivine Gym.
P16: Upon leaving the lighthouse, you receive a call from Warden Baoba. He informs you that the Safari Zone is finally open, and that it can be reached by traveling through 湛蓝市's Cliff Edge Gate.
C2:
Olivine City Pokémon Gym
Leader: Jasmine
The Steel-Clad Defense Girl
P17: The Olivine Gym specializes in 钢 Pokémon. Steel-type moves are super effective against 冰- and 岩石 Pokémon, while Steel-type Pokémon are weak to 格斗-, 火-, and 地面 moves.
P18: The Gym features neither puzzles to solve nor Gym Trainers to defeat, allowing challengers to reach the Gym Leader immediately.
P19: Both of Jasmine's two 小磁怪 can harass their target with 超音波 and 电磁波, though 地面 Pokémon are immune to the latter. Her 大钢蛇 is vulnerable to 火 attacks as well, but can retaliate with 落石 against unsuspecting Fire Pokémon. 刺耳声 lowers the target's 防御, while 铁尾 may do the same. Its low 特防 leaves it particularly vulnerable to special Fire- and 水 attacks.
P20: After the battle, Jasmine awards you the 矿物徽章. She also gives you 招式学习器23（铁尾） as a prize.
P21: Having now explored western Johto, the next destination is the region's mountainous northeast area. Fly back to 圆朱市 and head east to reach 42号道路.
P22: 42号道路 connects 圆朱市 to Mahogany Town in the east. The path runs along the base of 擂钵山, and is divided twice over by small lakes. Crossing these waters directly requires the use of 冲浪, but it is possible to detour through the mountain to avoid them. A grove of Apricorn trees grows in the middle of the route.

D8: From a Hiker leaving the western entrance to Mt. Mortar
D9: South of Mt. Mortar's middle entrance, on the western tree (daily; requires 冲浪, 居合斩)

P23: Just as you approach the western entrance to 擂钵山, a Hiker comes running out of the cave. He apologizes for bumping into you, and gives you 秘传学习器04（怪力） to make up for it. This field move lets a compatible Pokémon move large boulders with ease.
P24: A grove of Apricorn trees grows between the two lakes, blocked by an 居合斩. Enter this grove to find 水君 again, standing among the trees. It flees again when you get too close, dashing off eastward toward Mahogany Town. Eusine arrives a moment later, and mentions how you always seem to be around when Suicune appears. He is not worried though, as he believes his desire to search for the Pokémon surpasses your own. He reaffirms his commitment to find out what Suicune is looking for, and hurries off after it.
P25: 擂钵山 is a sprawling cave set deep into the northern mountains. It is an optional cave to enter, but contains many valuable items and Pokémon. Navigating the difficult terrain requires the use of 冲浪, 怪力, and 攀瀑. As such, it is not possible to reach every area on the first visit.
D17: Northeast of the western entrance, on a lone rock (hidden)
D18: West of the waterfall, accessed via Lower Cave
D19: East of the waterfall, accessed via Lower Cave
D21: In the darker patch of dirt, northeast of the boulder (hidden; requires 怪力)
D23: Central area, next to a group of five stalagmites (requires 怪力)
D24: East-central area, southeast of Super Nerd Markus (requires 怪力)
H18: Lower level (West Entrance to East Entrance)
P26: From the western cave entrance, go north and pass through the opening to reach the Lower Cave.
P27: Climb up the ladder to the northwest. This leads to the upper level of the Entrance, to the western platform atop the waterfall. Collect the ＰＰ单项小补剂 and climb back down the ladder.
P28: Go east and use 怪力 on the boulder to clear a path northward. Detour up the first stairway on the left to reach an 高级球, then continue northward. Pick up the 全满药 to the northeast, then turn eastward. The nearest stairway leads to Super Nerd Markus and a shortcut to the entrance. Continue eastward first to reach an 离洞绳 to the southeast, then climb the large stairway to collect a 金珠 to the north. Return to the boulder near the south wall. Head east and climb the stairway to reach a second ladder.
P29: This leads to the upper level of the Entrance, to the eastern platform atop the waterfall. Collect the 活力碎片 and climb back down the ladder.
P30: Go south to return to the Entrance.
P31: Head southeast to reach the eastern cave exit and return to 42号道路.
